subject: Confirming monthly band and PO signoff flow
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-01T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Confirming monthly band and PO signoff flow

Hi Samir —

Great to chat earlier. Quick recap from our discovery and two asks so we can size the pilot and surface procurement next steps:

Summary from call
- Primary workload: realtime patient triage assistant + anonymized notes embeddings for search; estimated average context length ~600 tokens, bursty peaks to 2.5k.
- Expected pilot traffic: 200–900k tokens/day (projecting ~6M–27M tokens/month) depending on ramp.

Two asks (can you confirm by EOD Wednesday?)
1) Target monthly spend band you’re comfortable committing to for the pilot (ballpark is fine). Example bands we typically see: <$10k, $10k–$30k, $30k–$80k.
2) Procurement thresholds and signoff process at Novum (PO minimums, legal review SLA, who issues POs). Specifically: is a PO required to start the pilot? Is there a PO $ threshold that requires Director/VP approval?

Pricing framing (for context, not final):
- Suggested unit economics for this workload: $18–$22 per 1M tokens for inference-only pilot; embedding calls priced separately (we can provide blended estimate in the attached workbook).
- For committed monthly bands we can offer improved unit rates and a short-term pilot discount; exact numbers depend on committed band and any term commitments.

Attachments: I attached a simple model (costed-pilot-math.xlsx) that maps tokens -> $/month at a few unit-rate scenarios.

If you confirm the band + procurement gates we’ll: 1) propose a two-month pilot banded SOW and pricing, 2) surface any required approval routing, and 3) pre-populate a PO template for your procurement team.

Thanks — Neha

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128

From: Samir Patel <samir@novumhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novumhealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming monthly band and PO signoff flow

Hi Neha — thanks for the recap and the workbook, useful. A few answers from our side: 

Pilot budget band
- We’re expecting to authorize a pilot in the $12k–$30k per month corridor as a starting point. We can stretch if outcomes look strong but procurement wants to see a bounded commitment.

Unit economics
- $20 per 1M tokens would be our internal target for inference during the pilot (embeddings we expect to be a smaller portion; hit me if you want the blended numbers).

Procurement gates
- PO is required to invoice us.
- Anything under $25k nominally can be signed by our Head of Product; $25k+ requires VP approval and procurement legal signoff (typically 30–45 days depending on redlines).
- We have an internal PO template procurement uses — happy to provide it once we land SOW numbers.

People
- Priya (procurement) is copied here; she’ll handle PO logistics.

Next step: please send a proposed pilot SOW and a one-page PO-friendly summary (line items + monthly band + expected invoice cadence).

—Samir

Samir Patel
Director, Product Operations | Novum Health
samir@novumhealth.com | +1 312-555-0912

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-03T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Confirming monthly band and PO signoff flow — Novum Health (pilot band clarity)

Karthik/Marissa — forwarding Samir’s note. Key datapoints: pilot band $12k–$30k/mo, target $20 per 1M tokens, PO required, PO threshold for VP signoff at $25k, legal review 30–45 days.

My questions: 
- For a two-month pilot, would we propose a committed band at $15k/month or $20k/month to hit both unit economics and procurement comfort? Low-risk ask is $15k with optional ramp.
- Discounting: can we offer an introductory pilot rate of $18/1M tokens for the first month and $20/1M thereafter under a 2-month SOW without Exec approval? If not, what level of discount requires Sales Ops / Rev Approval?
- PO handling: we’ll need a PO template and a stub SOW that procurement can drop into their process. Who's owned on our side to pre-fill legal redlines?

Quick notes: if we target $15k/month committed we can show them conservative consumption (approx 7.5M tokens/month at $20/1M = $150, but math in the workbook shows how projections vary). I attached the workbook I sent earlier for reference.

Thoughts?

Neha

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@novumhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novumhealth.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-05-04T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confirming monthly band and PO signoff flow

Hi Samir / Priya — thanks for the clarity, glad that banding matches expectations. Short reply with the next steps and concrete asks so procurement can move quickly.

1) Proposed pilot (what we’ll send today)
- Term: 2 months (start date TBD on PO execution)
- Committed monthly band: $15,000/month (we selected conservative middle of your band to reduce approval friction)
- Unit rate: $20 per 1M tokens (inference). Embeddings will be billed at $8 per 1M vectors for the pilot; we’ll provide a blended estimate in the SOW.
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears; SOW will include line items and a one-line PO-friendly summary.

2) Procurement & legal path
- Since this band is $15k/mo for 2 months ($30k total) it sits just under your VP approval trigger; should be manageable with Head of Product signoff and standard PO.
- We will pre-populate your PO template once you send it; legal redlines are usually minimal for a pilot SOW but we’ll include a standard liability/usage clause. Typical legal review at your side: 2–4 weeks.

3) Deliverables (by end of day)
- SOW v1 (SOW-novum-pilot-v1.pdf) — line-item pricing, expected KPIs, and measurement windows.
- One-page PO summary.
- Pre-filled PO template (if Priya can share it) and our standard master terms for legal.

Action items
- Priya: please send the procurement PO template and confirm the person who will sign the PO under $25k.
- Samir: confirm the start window you’d prefer (we recommended May 22 start to allow legal + PO cadence).

Happy to hop on a 15-minute call if that helps expedite.

Best —
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0128

Attachments: SOW-novum-pilot-v1.pdf
